## Simone de Beauvoir on freedom

Simone de Beauvoir (1908–1986) approaches freedom within existentialism and feminism. One is not born, but becomes, a woman—gender as historical situation, not fixed essence. Woman has been cast as man’s Other; liberation requires economic and existential autonomy. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets freedom most directly—useful for searches such as “simone de beauvoir quotes on freedom.”
